# Conversion and disposition query conditions use different representations

Proposed investigation from current source: Conversion still finds literal part= or convert=true in the spec; disposition parses URLParams and compares decoded types. Confirm behavior for escaped parameter names/values and substring matches in unrelated values. No malformed/escaped-URL case was executed. Static source inspection only. No Thunderbird runtime, build, lint, security experiment or live accessibility check ran. Full Bugzilla and Phabricator discussion remains pending.

Scope: Exchange query parsing questions.
